description: mice.impute.logreg(y, ry, x, wy) and mice.impute.logreg.boot(y, ry, x, wy) with every random number captured: normals = rnorm(q) (logreg; one per coefficient that is not aliased), integers = sample(n_obs, n_obs, TRUE) - 1 (logreg.boot), uniforms = runif(n_imp). order is the expected sequence of draws as [pool, count] pairs. coef (null where aliased), cov_unscaled (summary.glm, the coefficients that are not aliased), iter and converged come from glm.fit (quasibinomial on augmented data for logreg, binomial on the bootstrap sample for logreg.boot); beta_star are the coefficients of the prediction (aliased ones 0), prob the probabilities of the second level, levels the port's level order and imputed the port's labels (booleans for a logical target). Inputs: kind, y (labels; null for NA), levels (declared), ry, wy (null means !ry), x without intercept (null when p = 0). port: 'match' (R's result), 'rebuilt' (R stops, r_error, or returns something else, r_imputed; the port's computation rebuilt with mice's augment and glm.fit), 'one_category' (the port imputes the single category without fit or draws; R's output in r_imputed) or 'value_error' (more than two categories).
